author: everestmcarthur
install_msg: Welcome to **EveCogs**! Use `[p]cog list` to see available cogs.
name: EveCogs
short: A collection of advanced cogs for Red-DiscordBot.
description: EveCogs is a premium cog repository featuring NexusCore (the ultimate all-in-one server management cog with tickets, applications, suggestions, reaction roles, giveaways, logging, moderation & economy), Wormhole v3.4.0 (cross-server relay with 85+ hybrid commands, context menus, ToS gate, reports, analytics & more), NewHelpMenu (Components V2 help overhaul), VoiceMeister (ultimate temporary voice channel system with Join-to-Create, persistent control panel, name templates, game detection & logging), and SelfbotGuard (advanced selfbot detection).
